lead.name: Kabeer
lead.trait: Turns a rough idea into a working page by evening.

title: Golf League Desk
oneLiner: Phone web tool for weekly golf league secretaries: league handicaps, weekly pairings, points and standings, shared as a read-only link
customer: Volunteer secretaries of small weekly golf leagues (9 hole after work, men's and women's club leagues) in the US
revenueModel: Free handicap and standings page, paid one season unlock for a full league

evidence.claim: DataForSEO Google Ads US 12 month average: golf league management software 1,900 a month, peaking at 6,600 in June 2026.
Golf League Network sells league management (handicaps, pairings, standings, scoring) with only a 3 round free trial.
GolfSoftware.com sells golf league software from a buy page, so secretaries already pay for this job.

nextAction: Lead Kabeer: validate. Find prices on each paid tool's own page (GolfSoftware.com, Golf League Network, Golf League Tracker, League Genius), look hard for any free no-account web tool that runs a whole league (kill if one does, as mahj-league and rally-rounds died that way), and check whether a static site with on-device data and a shared read-only link can do the job with no backend. Against: buyer search is seasonal (70 to 110 a month in Sep to Oct, 3,600 to 6,600 in May to Aug), so a page must be live and indexed by April.
